notes: Prior-strength ESS accounting: effective_ess = alpha_applied*ess per source; composed_ess sums it on the power path only when every contributing source declares ess (None otherwise, and always None on the mixture path since moment-matching folds in between-component spread); kish_ess is a Kish (1965) concentration diagnostic over the weights actually used (applied alphas on the power path, mixture weights on the mixture path).

oracle.method: Gaussian precision arithmetic: effective_ess = alpha*ess per source and the composed and Kish ESS values follow from the stated weights (README, four analytic scenarios)
asserted_outputs: Kish ESS on the power path
oracle.independence_basis: The generator applies the stated accounting rules (effective = alpha*ess; composed is the sum only when every source declares ess; Kish 1965 concentration) in plain Python; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the fixture notes that define the accounting.
oracle.historical_exposure: The original values were pinned in an earlier import whose harness was not retained; this reference was written during this review from the fixture formula and declared inputs, with the executing assertion read to establish which values it compares and no product implementation source consulted. Who first derived the pinned numbers is unrecorded.
